channel.title: Pier & Point · Crescent Cove
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Crescent Cove (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Crescent Cove: Crescent Cove now uses its Assessor lot lines.
item.description: Crescent Cove now uses its Assessor lot lines. Source: DataSF Assessor parcels (acdm-wktn), lot 8703006.

item.title: Correction · Crescent Cove: The map notes said the completion year was unconfirmed; David Baker Architects, The Real Deal and DBI permit 200505112108 (completed 2007-10-30) all give 2007, so the notes were corrected. The summary now cites The Real Deal for the 60% AMI rents and the developers and says 'a waterfront park' as that article does, the cost entry no longer calls the building affordable on the permit's authority, an earlier change entry now names the permit, and the Commons photo no longer says it was taken from a departing flight.
item.description: The map notes said the completion year was unconfirmed; David Baker Architects, The Real Deal and DBI permit 200505112108 (completed 2007-10-30) all give 2007, so the notes were corrected.
